This run had several notable events worth capturing accurately and in order: (1) the PIN-03 AC3 scope decision at Step 1/1b (CODE-DESIGNER PARTIAL, CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR PASS with explicit acknowledgment) -- a design-time choice, not a defect, matching PIN-01's own precedent pattern from the prior batch almost exactly; (2) an ADHOC mid-run infrastructure fix for ISS-0688/GH-745 (a pre-existing regression, NOT part of this batch's own requirements, discovered by BACKEND-DEV during Step 2a verification: two dead calls to a dropped SQL function bpm_effective_tenant_id() in src/engine/instance.zig plus 9 further survivor call sites across five more files, breaking POST /api/v1/instances entirely under SCHEMA mode) -- fixed via an ADHOC BACKEND-DEV dispatch before the pipeline could proceed, since it blocked this run's own testability, then re-reviewed by SECURITY-REVIEWER as part of the normal Step 2c gate; (3) a genuine TEST-DESIGNER discovery at Step 3 that PIN-04 AC2/AC3 (sub-process pin inheritance and conflict recording) was claimed implemented by BACKEND-DEV's Step 2a summary but was actually unimplemented -- 2 real, fail-first-confirmed tests written against the literal AC text rather than skipped, triggering REWORK 1 on the BACKEND-DEV handoff, a SECURITY-REVIEWER re-review PASS on the new tenant-data-path logic, and independent confirmation by TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR that a bundled test-fixture edit BACKEND-DEV made during the same rework commit was a legitimate reachability fix and not a weakened assertion; (4) RELEASE-VALIDATOR's own additional finding (ISS-0689/GH-748, a stale doc comment in the PIN-04 test file) discovered independently at Step 5.

As Step Final of this workflow, manage the GitHub feature branch to completion per your own agent file's mandatory GitHub Branch Management procedure: BEFORE pushing anything, `git fetch origin main` and rebase/merge if origin/main has moved (expected in this multi-workspace environment -- integrate cleanly, do not treat it as an error). Push the branch, create the PR, run `python tools/check_github_status.py` (mandatory, quote its actual output before characterizing any CI check), wait for/verify checks pass, squash-merge, delete the branch, confirm repo returns to a clean main. Do NOT skip or defer this -- it is this run's own Step Final, mandatory per core-directives.md's Zero Manual Work / GitHub Branch Management rules, not something ORCH does separately afterward.

CRITICAL ENVIRONMENT NOTE: this shell's process environment may carry a stale BPM_TEST_DB_URL from a different workspace -- irrelevant for pure doc/git work, but if you run any build/test verification command, run `unset BPM_TEST_DB_URL BPM_DB_URL BPM_BENCH_DB_URL` first and export .env's real values.
